verdict.rationale: DPMA offers online filing routes (DPMAdirektWeb and DPMAdirektPro), so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions operating hours, maintenance windows, per-day submission limits, or session timeouts published before filing. The deadlines cited (internal priority, translation periods) are legal procedural time limits, not limits on the online flow itself.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
